agent: Codex collaboration agents, fresh no-history sessions
tools: local file reading/writing only; browsing and product runtime unavailable
evaluation: parent reviewed actual outputs against criteria; no baseline, not blind reviewer

criteria.criterion: Converts 2500000 rial to 250000 toman once and total to 280000 toman
criteria.evidence: Money row states 250000 toman and 280000 total, with conversion only once at the contract boundary.

criteria.criterion: Flags fractional/rounding decision for 2500001 rial
criteria.evidence: Fractional row states 250000.1 toman and requires an explicit rounding/display policy.

criteria.criterion: Keeps canonical phone/OTP strings and leading zeroes
criteria.evidence: Phone and OTP rows retain canonical string forms and 0123, including leading zero.

criteria.criterion: Distinguishes date-only from instant and names selected calendar/zone
criteria.evidence: Date rows separate 1405-07-15 date-only from a real instant; selected calendar is Persian and zone Asia/Tehran.

criteria.criterion: Marks SMS/backend/runtime unverified and preserves unresolved payment
criteria.evidence: Opening and payment rows disclose absent code/browser/backend and unobserved SMS; pending remains unresolved.

criteria.criterion: States total 280000 toman with supplied components
criteria.evidence: Final amount block lists 250000 goods, 30000 shipping and 280000 total in toman.

criteria.criterion: Applies supplied 72-hour policy only to verified failure with source-account return and support route
criteria.evidence: Verified-failure block conditionally returns deducted funds to the same source account within fixture 72-hour policy; reference, amount and time go to support.

criteria.criterion: Adds no refund/debit/retry claim to pending state
criteria.evidence: Unresolved-payment block makes no success/failure/refund/retry claim; debit remains unknown.

criteria.criterion: Adds no invented OTP expiry/resend or unsupported service promise
criteria.evidence: OTP has no invented expiry or resend interval; out-of-area text limits service to Shiraz.

criteria.criterion: Normalizes B to 280000 toman and preserves original units
criteria.evidence: Comparison table preserves 2800000 rial and normalizes B to 280000 toman.

criteria.criterion: Leaves final A unknown and declares no cheapest overall winner
criteria.evidence: Conclusion leaves A total unknown, with only conditional shipping comparisons, not a cheapest overall winner.

criteria.criterion: Reports artifact/contract comparison rather than observed live flows
criteria.evidence: Opening and table label synthetic contract comparison and unobserved login/payment/support/delivery.

criteria.criterion: Names comparable city/payment/support evidence to gather
criteria.evidence: Next checks require same purchase conditions/address in Shiraz, shipping, support and confirmed payment evidence.

criteria.criterion: Labels all proposed barriers hypotheses
criteria.evidence: Hypothesis table labels all four barriers as unproven and provides opposing observations.

criteria.criterion: Uses neutral last-experience questions and real service-area recruitment
criteria.evidence: Recruitment is recent repair experience in Shiraz; free last-experience questions precede targeted prompts.

criteria.criterion: Includes total-cost unit, SMS/recovery and alternative-provider questions only when relevant
criteria.evidence: Interview plan asks unit/final cost, SMS failure/recovery and alternatives only for relevant experience.

criteria.criterion: Makes no national demand/trust claim or inferred famous-brand preference
criteria.evidence: No national trust/demand inference; brand mentions are explicitly not evidence of Shiraz coverage or preference.

criteria.criterion: Corrects conventional priceCurrency IRR amount to 2500000 and does not invent IRT ISO code
criteria.evidence: First priority corrects price=2500000 with IRR, preserving 250000 toman display and rejecting invented IRT ISO code.

criteria.criterion: Separates localized date display from required machine format
criteria.evidence: Date row keeps Persian display and requires Gregorian machine format; no fabricated instant for a date-only value.

criteria.criterion: Rejects fabricated service areas and duplicate spelling/location pages
criteria.evidence: Coverage row rejects unserved cities; query row rejects separate pages for near-identical spelling variants.

criteria.criterion: Keeps current policy/indexing/SMS/traffic unverified
criteria.evidence: Opening and verification sections keep current policy, live indexing, traffic and SMS unverified.
